entities.title: A 3D game in Godot 4, not a retro page
entities.summary: Gambit is a stylish 3D game made in Godot 4, not an 8-bit page.
entities.context: The first version was an 8-bit pixel-art web page. The owner asked for something very stylish instead.
entities.decision: Godot 4 as a 3D game; GDD.md's pillar "Stylish, not retro".

entities.title: Compatibility renderer, single-threaded export, models in code
entities.summary: Godot 4.7.2, GDScript, the Compatibility renderer (WebGL 2) and a single-threaded web export; every model is made in code.
entities.context: The game runs in a browser from a Cloudflare Worker that sets no cross-origin isolation headers.
entities.decision: renderer gl_compatibility; the Web preset with thread_support off and no cross-origin isolation headers; pieces from lathe profiles and a lofted knight (PieceMeshes), sounds synthesised (Sfx), no art or sound files.
entities.rationale: A single-threaded export runs without SharedArrayBuffer, so it needs no cross-origin isolation; WebGL 2 reaches the most browsers.
entities.decidedBy: Claude, recorded in the GDD's decision log
